data.title: AI breakthrough: Why life on the Moon and Mars could happen much sooner - Futura-Sciences
data.description: In deep space environments, isolated hardware failures can terminate a mission. Because distance prevents sending physical repair crews or spare parts from Earth, predictive maintenance represents a major shift in space engineering.
